explication: Superdesign is an agent-facing design skill, distributed here both as a packaged skill and as a DeepSeek Harness provider. The principal workflow is: a developer asks a coding agent for design work; the skill gathers codebase context and style direction, then guides canvas-based drafts or other design outputs. The README documents broader capabilities, while the only sampled runtime source implements skill discovery and retrieval; links among the documented design stages are therefore based on README evidence, not inspected implementation.
